$ go test  # echo
    boom: The code panics on this sheet.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        echo panicked: index out of range
        Fix the code. A panic is never an expected error.
        out/echo/error.txt has no golden.
        Run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... to write it, and read it before committing.
    stack of the panic: [stack]
--- FAIL: TestCorpus
    --- FAIL: TestCorpus/boom
        --- FAIL: TestCorpus/boom/echo
    --- PASS: TestCorpus/calm
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/calm/echo
FAIL
[exit 1]
